name: rust
description: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
one_liner: The free programming language itself, plus the compiler that turns Rust code into a running program.
buyer: Nobody buys this directly; it's a free language and compiler that companies build products on top of, not a product itself.
business_use_cases: A company builds a performance-critical product (databases, browsers, embedded firmware) in Rust because it avoids whole classes of memory-safety bugs.
A consultancy sells Rust migration and training services to companies moving performance-sensitive code off C/C++.
A tooling vendor builds and sells IDE plugins, CI integrations, or observability tools aimed specifically at Rust codebases.

money_ideas.idea: None for the compiler itself; money is made in services and tools built around the language, not the language.

steal_this: Not a weekend business idea on its own. If anything, the honest move is to build a paid tool or course for Rust developers, not to monetize the compiler.
